findings.text: follow-on: _staging_review_record_by_run re-walks the review store directory (review_store_root()/project/*.json, one _read_json_object per file) to match on review_run_id, duplicating the indexed store scan the same store already owns for its reviewed_run_id lookups (_store_index/_build_store_index, reckon/crew/review.py:2076-2101), whose comment calls a whole-store pass per lookup the dominant cost of a per-turn reader. The run-review path correctly extends recovery._delivered_review_record; the plan-review fallback could instead key the store index on review_run_id. Modest, because a promotion is not a per-turn path, but it is a second scan where the owner exists.
